kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أختتن (form VIII)
# أَخْتَتِنُ (ʔaḵtatinu) /ʔax.ta.ti.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# أُخْتَتَنُ (ʔuḵtatanu) /ʔux.ta.ta.nu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# أَخْتَتِنَ (ʔaḵtatina) /ʔax.ta.ti.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# أُخْتَتَنَ (ʔuḵtatana) /ʔux.ta.ta
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
